# Magnifica Humanitas — León XIV

## What stays with me
Subsidiarity is not a management technique. The decision belongs to the one it lands on, and the leader's job is to put the question there.

## The test I run on every AI decision
Does this concrete use of AI, in this concrete place, serve the dignity of the person, their vocation and the common good? Three quick checks: is the person running after the machine or the reverse; is it clear who answers if it goes wrong; did we ask the one it lands on.

## Where it showed up
Ferra: I trained the assistant on the supervisors instead of the supervisors on the assistant. That was this test, before I had the words for it.
